description: youtube: Channel Search. GET /v1/youtube/channel/search. Provide one of: handle, continuationToken. Search within one YouTube channel by keyword. Returns videos, Shorts, live streams and playlists. Costs 1 credit per page, even with no matches. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

continuationToken.description: Token from the previous response. Keep the same handle and query; stop when the token is null.

handle.description: YouTube channel handle, with or without @.

query.description: Keywords to search within this channel.

name: youtube_channel_search
